prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished 16:9 PC fantasy game UI concept image. The supplied Blender image is the environment reference: preserve its isometric room composition and warm lighting for screen mockups; it is not an edit target. All numbers, products and key bindings are temporary visual placeholders. Readable Chinese labels, practical mouse targets, no watermark, no website chrome. Keep scene view visible where appropriate. Do not include a character in the 3D room.
STYLE B — Luminous illustrated field journal: warm ivory vellum panels, walnut wood edges, copper hardware, inked botanical sketches, hand-painted icons, charcoal text, muted terracotta highlights. Bright and inviting, booklike and tactile. Much lighter than the previous dark forest-green/brass UI; modest ornament, strong contrast, no dark-green full-screen panels.
SHOP HUD. Top-left small red panda portrait and compact health/stamina bars; top-right coins '1,280' and '第 3 天'. One contextual 'F 查看商品' prompt near the center display. Bottom-right compact entries '背包 B', '订单 J', '装修 R', '设置 Esc'. Bottom-center tiny '营业中'. Keep the room unobstructed and avoid giant HUD panels.
